records.source: Reuters / bank balance estimates and Gulf product divergence
records.claim: Reuters cites JPMorgan global oil market surplus estimates of 1.1m b/d in September and 1.4m b/d in October; Goldman Sachs assessed flat stocks; Vortexa Gulf October crude and condensate 14m b/d (~86% pre-war) and refined products 3.1m b/d (just over half normal); near-term Brent swaps contango while Jan 2027+ futures backwardated.
records.observation: November 6 publication synthesizes earlier-month flows and bank estimates, not new November 6 operating capacity.
records.assessment: EVIDENCE UPDATE — DIFFERENT PHYSICAL FLOWS AND MARKET TENORS

records.source: Reuters / Vortexa and Kpler Gulf oil tanker tracking
records.claim: Vortexa Gulf October crude/condensate exports 14.0m b/d (86% pre-war) and products 3.1m b/d (just over half normal); AIS blackout and later satellite verification mean estimates may be revised up; Kpler uses different coverage, with Iran excluded.
records.observation: Earlier publication of same measurement source, not independent repetition or newly dated physical change.

records.source: Reuters / China November diesel exports and inventories
records.claim: China November diesel exports forecast below 800000 tonnes; commercial diesel inventories estimated 11.1m tonnes at end October, lowest since data series began in 2011. Forecast not a full-month measured export outcome.
records.observation: November 5 earlier-day product-stock constraint contextualizing differentiated recovery.
records.assessment: CONTEXT — FORECAST NOT OBSERVED NOVEMBER EXPORT
